expectation: Nuclear stain, round dots filling the nucleus, in regulatory T cells (a subset of CD4+ cells). Uncommon: scattered single cells, more of them in lymphoid aggregates and stroma with immune infiltrate, and often weak in some tumours.
observed: A: haze over tissue and slide, tiles, bright speckle on and off tissue. B and C: haze and a few bright blobs, no nuclear dots. D: even yellow haze, no cells. E: E1 granules follow cell density; E3 green is mostly debris beside CD4 cells, rarely on them.
why: Nothing shows a distinct nuclear-stained subset of cells: only haze, tiling and debris, and in row E FOXP3 does not sit on the CD4+ cells.
notes: FOXP3 shows haze that follows the tissue, tile artefacts and bright debris speckle on and off the tissue, with no nuclear dots at any scale. In the CD4-dense field the few green spots are blobs beside CD4 cells, not FOXP3 nuclei within them.
